episodes.overview: Go behind the scenes with director Dallas Jenkins as he hops around New York City and Washington DC in a jam-packed media blitz for The Chosen.

episodes.name: Andrew: The heart of the character
episodes.overview: Andrew, brother of Simon Peter, is one of the unsung heroes of the gospels. We love his portrayal by Noah James, who auditioned for three roles (the shepherd, Simon, and Matthew) before being cast as the immediate and passionate follower of Jesus.

episodes.name: Meet the couple behind your Chosen gear
episodes.overview: For the first time, Dallas visits where your Chosen gear gets made and gets a behind the scenes look at the what, the how, and most important, the who of The Chosen’s merchandise.

episodes.name: Jesus in every language?
episodes.overview: Our goal is to reach a billion people in as many languages as we can... check out what's happening...

episodes.name: “The most rewarding experience of my career.” - seeing The Chosen for the first time
episodes.overview: Our head writer, Ryan Swanson, takes you behind the scenes of a “rough cut” as he describes his first time seeing The Chosen.

episodes.name: What Exactly is a Script Supervisor? - The Chosen on set
episodes.overview: Meet The Chosen's script supervisor and see how she helps bring script to the screen.

episodes.name: Grips, Gaffers, and Martinis: The Chosen's guide to film terms
episodes.overview: Not every film set uses phrases like “loaves and fishes” or “get used to different,” but they all use terms like “speeding” and “key grip.” This video tells you exactly what those and other film-specific terms mean.

episodes.name: Miracle of the Dirt
episodes.overview: Do you pray for the Chosen? Wonder if it’s working in between seasons? Here’s why we ask for your prayers and here’s why you need to keep it up.

episodes.name: "What's a film grip?" On set with The Chosen's
episodes.overview: Grips play an important role on The Chosen, the first-ever multi-season show about Jesus. But what exactly do grips do? Do they all have epic beards?

episodes.name: VFX before and after - The Chosen
episodes.overview: One of our visual effects companies, VFX Magic, assembled these clips of some of the unique effects in The Chosen, some of which you may not have noticed.

episodes.name: Not all Pharisees are bad guys
episodes.overview: When we researched The Chosen, our understanding of Nicodemus and the Pharisees shifted a bit. So did the way we portray them.

episodes.name: The Chosen did all THIS on one small set?
episodes.overview: Enjoy this walkthrough our Texas site with a look at the various scenes we filmed in each spot. I think you’ll agree we made the most of a small space!

episodes.name: The Chosen creates the Sea of Galilee in Texas
episodes.overview: For this emotional scene, we took a shallow ravine and turned it into a cliff overlooking the Sea of Galilee using blue screen, shooting targets, and a little movie magic.

episodes.name: How The Chosen Season 2 will look
episodes.overview: Want a glimpse of the filming plans for season two? See Dallas and some crew walk through each location and scene being filmed in the next 6 weeks.

episodes.name: The Chosen No One Sees: Set building and scriptwriting
episodes.overview: Associate Producer Justen Overlander shares Chosen set building surprises with you and pitches his "interesting" story idea for future seasons to co-writer Tyler Thompson.

episodes.name: The Chosen no one sees
episodes.overview: You see our “behind the scenes” stuff all the time, but our associate producer Justen wants to give you some insights, private access, and conversations with cast and crew you won’t get anywhere else.

episodes.name: Dallas gives you secret Chosen tour
episodes.overview: The day before filming, Dallas pulled out his phone, pressed record, and walked through the entire set, sharing with you insights about every corner of where we'll be filming Season 2.

episodes.name: Writers Decide How The Chosen Will End
episodes.overview: The Chosen writers give you a glimpse into their recent week-long writing retreat, where the entire rest of the series was plotted out. BONUS: some exclusive insights into Season 2!

episodes.name: Not your grandma's Jesus show
episodes.overview: The opening credits and theme song set The Chosen apart from other shows about Jesus and have gotten a ton of response. Here we take you behind the scenes of how it all came together, the meaning behind the design and the song, and how the opening credits set the tone for the series.

episodes.name: Directing The Chosen: A day on set with Dallas Jenkins
episodes.overview: What exactly does a director do? In the midst of all the impact and excitement of The Chosen, the show still has to get made. We thought you’d enjoy a look inside a day on the set from Dallas’s perspective.

episodes.name: You Won't Believe How Much We Filmed Here...
episodes.overview: Notice how Season 2’s sets seemed bigger? We’re taking you on a guided tour through every corner of our set so you can see which scenes filmed where.

episodes.name: Finishing The Chosen
episodes.overview: Dallas getting pranked isn’t even the best part of this video from Chris & Kris. You’ll also see how we make sure every word and sound you hear matters.

episodes.name: A look inside The Chosen editing room
episodes.overview: Who’s the editor, what’s the editing “language” of the show, and does Dallas hate music? Chris & Kris take you into the editing room of The Chosen and find out how it all works.

episodes.name: Airplanes Ruined Jesus's Line? Here's how we fixed it.
episodes.overview: Our story is set in the 1st century, but did you know some of our dialogue is delivered in a studio in Los Angeles? Chris & Kris show you why.

episodes.name: Strange Voices in The Chosen
episodes.overview: Did you know background actors don’t actually say anything? Chris & Kris show you where those voices come from and teach you about “looping,” “donuts,” and bad British accents.

episodes.name: The Story Behind the Music of The Chosen
episodes.overview: Fan of the music in The Chosen? Chris & Kris went to L.A. to talk to our co-composer and take you behind the process of getting the music into the episodes.

episodes.name: Dallas Shared These Important Words on The Chosen Set
episodes.overview:
Right before we filmed the epic finale of Christmas With The Chosen, Dallas gathered the crowd, band, and crew for this spontaneous encouragement about the entire point of The Chosen.

He also shared what he believes is the single most important word in the song “Joy to the World.”

episodes.name: Fire on the Set
episodes.overview: Fire on the set!  That’s real fire in those torches, cauldrons, and lanterns. How do they keep it safe? Chris & Kris give you an inside look at how our team goes the extra mile for authenticity.

episodes.name: The Chosen’s murder scene; Was Jesus follower a murderer?
episodes.overview: Was one of Jesus’ followers a potential murderer? Is it plausible Simon the zealot would have planned assassination plots before he met Jesus? We think so, and here we take you inside the set as we filmed one of our most complex scenes in our biggest episode ever.

episodes.name: We're Building an Ancient City in Texas!
episodes.overview: How did we create a historically accurate 1st century set in the middle of 21st century Texas? In this video, we introduce you to our incredible set designers—James and Jeff—who step you through the streets of Capernaum, from Matthew’s house to the synagogue. Plus, you don’t want to miss the little competition they’ve set up for you…

episodes.name: The Inside Look at the Chosen Costumes
episodes.overview: If you’ve ever had questions or been intrigued by our costumes, join Chris & Kris as they take you inside the world of The Chosen costume design and introduce you to our designer.

episodes.name: How we shot the Miracle of the Fish
episodes.overview: The emotional moment when Simon decided to follow Jesus was also one of our toughest to shoot. Watch how our team used a "big green burrito" to get this pivotal miracle from Season 1 Episode Four.

episodes.name: How we shot Jesus healing the leper
episodes.overview: You can take a front-row seat as Dallas, cast, and crew work through the logistics of filming this emotional and impactful miracle from Matthew chapter 8. It's also the introduction of fan-favorite Tamar, played by Amber Shana Williams.

episodes.name: Watch us film Season 4
episodes.overview: Now that Season 4 is a wrap, here's a roundup of some of our favorite moments from filming. Enjoy!

episodes.name: We take you on the first Season 4 set tour!
episodes.overview: Our Chosen Insiders give you a first look at the scenes being set up for Season 4. See how much thought and attention to detail goes into building a believable first-century world where our story unfolds.

episodes.name: Our Chosen Insiders give you a first look at the scenes being set up for Season 4. See how much thought and attention to detail goes into building a believable first-century world where our story unfolds.
episodes.overview: This summer, more than 600 fans made the trip to Goshen, Utah, to help us film some big Season 4 scenes. In this video, you’ll meet some of them and hear what motivated them to travel from other states (or even farther!) to be part of making The Chosen.

episodes.name: The Chosen—MINUS the MUSIC 🎶
episodes.overview: Don't know about you, but we feel like something's missing without the musical score in these three big scenes. We'll go ahead and keep our composers around. ;)

episodes.name: The Jesus backpack's amazing story
episodes.overview: We've gotten tons of comments and questions about the "Jesus backpack." The story behind it moved us deeply.

episodes.name: Bringing John 3:16 to screen
episodes.overview:
The nighttime encounter between Nicodemus and Jesus from John 3 was always going to be a climax of Season One.  The pressure to accurately, and with impact, capture the most famous conversation in the Bible was immense. But because we spent multiple episodes setting it up, and because of the brilliant performances of our two actors, the scene surpassed our expectations.

Here’s a look behind our full day of filming this scene.

episodes.name: The healing at Zebedee's: On the set
episodes.overview:
Episode 6 features a famous healing, the paralytic being lowered through the roof. So many issues at play, from the challenge of the Pharisees to the growing crowds to the faith of friends.

Here’s a look inside “Zebedee week,” the filming in extreme heat of most of Episode 6.

episodes.name: Water to Wine: The Chosen's Wedding at Cana
episodes.overview:
Episode 5 features one of the most famous miracles in the Bible, the water to wine. We also portrayed a Jewish wedding through the eyes of Jesus, his mother Mary, the disciples, and Thomas.

Here’s an inside look at “wedding week,” the filming of the wedding at Cana.

episodes.name: The Chosen Scene: Pool of Bethesda (Deep Dive)
episodes.overview: Before we launched The Chosen, we knew the pool of Bethesda healing from John 5 would be a signature moment. Here we take you from our trip to Israel to inside the entire week of filming one of the biggest, most complicated, and important scenes of the show.

episodes.name: Why did Jesus pair up the disciples?
episodes.overview: Sometimes, the Bible leaves a lot to the imagination. That’s true of the disciples’ first big mission. We know Jesus sent them out two by two to preach and heal, but we don’t know who got paired up or why. In this video, members of our cast and writing team give you The Chosen’s approach to choosing the duos and telling their stories.

episodes.name: Fighting words: Jesus’ teaching stirs up trouble
episodes.overview: What happens when good news and the best of intentions go terribly wrong? Season 3 wrestled with that question as Jesus’ words preached by Andrew and Philip caused deep division and conflict in the melting pot region of the Decapolis.

episodes.name: Their common enemy is Jesus
episodes.overview:
Unless you’re a history major (or spend all your time thinking about the Roman Empire), the political and religious landscape in The Chosen can be a little confusing. If Rome’s in charge, who’s this King Herod guy? And what about this Jewish “congress”, the Sanhedrin? And those odd-sounding religious factions—Pharisees, Saduccees, Zealots, etc.?

If any of that’s unclear, this video’s for you. Listen as co-writer, Tyler Thompson, gives you a crash course history lesson on all the rival rulers carving out their own kingdoms in Jesus’ day—and ultimately, finding Him to be their common enemy.

episodes.name: What Motivated Judas To Betray Jesus?
episodes.overview: We know what Judas will do. The question is why. In this video, Dallas, our writers, and actor Luke Dimyan consider Judas’ state of mind as he takes his first steps toward betrayal and what might have plausibly motivated him to break bad.

episodes.name: Casting the Chosen
episodes.overview: The process of finding the actors to play some of the most iconic and influential people in history was daunting but ultimately beautiful. And it’s not only impacted viewers, but the actors themselves.

episodes.name: The Plot Behind John the Baptist's Death
episodes.overview: John the Baptist's death wasn't simply premeditated—it was choreographed with lethal precision. Our cast, writers, and director retrace all the steps leading to John's tragic, yet hopeful end.

episodes.name: The Miracle of the Miracle of the Fish
episodes.overview: The story behind the climactic scene of episode 4 of The Chosen is as powerful as the scene itself. See why it’s our favorite episode.

episodes.name: Why our Walking on Water scene looked so real...
episodes.overview: If you found our walking on water scene believable, that's because we faked as little as possible. The waves, wind, and rain were all real. And the footing...well, it was firmer than water, but far from solid ground.

episodes.name: Could Matthew Have Been Simon Peter's Tax Collector?
episodes.overview: On our research trip to Israel, we visited Capernaum, the town where our first season is set, and looked into disciples Matthew and Simon Peter.

episodes.name: The Chosen visits wedding miracle site
episodes.overview: The Chosen director Dallas Jenkins and biblical consultant Rabbi Jason Sobel visit the site of Jesus' first public miracle and take you deeper into the scripture.

episodes.name: At the Sea of Galilee: “The Chosen will catch a lot of fish.”
episodes.overview: Our research trip to Israel brought us beautiful biblical insights about fishing, nets, and how The Chosen can be a net to gather more “fish.”

episodes.name: Why is the woman at the well so important? (The Chosen in Israel)
episodes.overview:
We knew before we started writing that Jesus’ encounter with the Samaritan woman at the well would be the climax of Season One.

The story has so many beautiful layers, and Dallas and Rabbi Jason explored them at the actual location in Israel.

episodes.name: Easter with The Chosen: Death to Resurrection
episodes.overview: We wouldn't have made The Chosen without going to Israel first. The cultural, historical, biblical, and artistic foundations of The Chosen are rooted in the insights gained here.

episodes.name: Garden of Gethsemane: the surprising significance of the olive trees
episodes.overview:
As you celebrate the victory of Easter, it's vital to understand the significance of the Garden of Gethsemane. Before we produced The Chosen, we went to Israel to go deeper into the stories we're telling you.

The meaning and importance of olive trees truly impacted us.

episodes.name: We're featuring this disciple in The Chosen - The Chosen in Israel
episodes.overview: We chose this disciple as one of our main characters because of the special way Jesus called him and how fast he responded.

episodes.name: The Importance of the Jewishness of Jesus
episodes.overview: We all know Da Vinci couldn't have gotten Jesus and the disciples to all pose on one side of the table... but more importantly... we should all know that Jesus and the disciples weren't all white.

episodes.name: The Chosen team visited Israel with Rabbi Jason Sobel - The Chosen in Israel
episodes.overview: Prayer is at the center of everything we do for The Chosen. Here's the special beginning to our research trip to Israel.

episodes.name: Our profound discovery about Gethsemane
episodes.overview: When he first set out to make The Chosen, Dallas visited Israel to get a deeper understanding of the story in its original setting. What he discovered about the Garden of Gethsemane—the place where Jesus agonized right before His arrest—made a huge impact and gave new meaning to that story. And now, years later, you can see how that discovery affected the making of Gethsemane in Season 5.

episodes.name: Bible Roundtable: S5 E1
episodes.overview: Jesus fulfills an old prophecy and makes a new one. He offers a powerful prayer and hears an audible voice from Heaven. He rides into a joyful city, but weeps over its coming destruction. And all of that’s just Episode 1. There’s a lot to talk about, and our Messianic Jewish rabbi, Catholic priest, and Evangelical scholar are back to discuss it all.

episodes.name: Bible Roundtable: S5 E2
episodes.overview: It’s time for some lively table talk—literally—as our Bible consultants discuss Jesus turning over tables. They discuss (and disagree over) whether Jesus cleansed the Temple once or twice. And along with explaining why He got so righteously angry, they also consider the deep meaning of his actions from a Jewish perspective—and how it revealed Him as the Father’s Son.

episodes.name: Bible Roundtable: S5 E3
episodes.overview: Episode 3 covered a lot of ground Biblically—and all of it pretty weighty stuff—so there’s much to discuss. Our scholars address the religious leaders’ attempt to publicly discredit Jesus, His equally public denouncement of them, and his private prediction to the disciples about the end of the age. And despite all the conflict and sadness throughout the episode, they point us to the words of hope and peace at the beginning and end.

episodes.name: Bible Roundtable: S5 E4
episodes.overview: It’s time to talk about the most bone-chilling scene in the entire season—the moment when Judas gives himself over to “not God.” Our biblical experts weigh in on nagging questions about Jesus’ betrayer. Was he trying to do good or harm? Was he bad from the beginning, or did he stray along the way? Was he a conscious agent or a pawn in a bigger plan? They also discuss perhaps the most surprising question and controversy that came out of this episode: Did Jesus pray for Judas?

episodes.name: Bible Roundtable: S5 E5
episodes.overview:
You’ve seen Jesus get angry at corruption in His Father’s house and hypocrisy within the religious leadership, but now, you’ve also seen Him snap at a tree. The “Cursing of the Fig Tree,” has stumped many Christians over the centuries, but Dallas promises our Bible consultants will fig-ure it out. ;)

Puns notwithstanding, this discussion truly gives us a solid understanding of the spiritual, historical, and symbolic meaning of what’s been a confusing Bible passage for many.

episodes.name: Bible Roundtable: S5 E6
episodes.overview:
In Episode 6, we saw the first Communion at the Last Supper. The Chosen’s portrayal stuck closely to Jesus’ words straight from the Gospels, but there’s a longstanding Catholic-Protestant disagreement over how to interpret those words. How literal or figurative was Jesus being when He said, “This is my body,” and “This is my blood”?

In this discussion, Father Guffey clearly presents the Catholic viewpoint. Dr. Huffman presents a continuum of Protestant views, and Rabbi Sobel brings in a Jewish perspective, connecting the Lord’s Supper to Passover—and all the way back to the trees in the Garden of Eden. Despite any differences of interpretation, one thing is clear: everyone takes Jesus’ words seriously and believes in the sacredness of this sacrament.

episodes.name: Bible Roundtable: S5 E7
episodes.overview:
Matthew, Luke, and John—the three Gospel writers we all know. Oh, wait! There’s a fourth. Episode 7 introduced us to Mark, but it also left us with several questions about him. Was he really so young? And was the Upper Room really part of his house? Our consultants dig into the history of Mark and that upstairs room where so many important events happened.

But first, Dallas has some questions about footwashing, and the insights from Rabbi Sobel just might knock your socks off.

episodes.name: Bible Roundtable: S5 E8
episodes.overview: Did Abraham, Ezekiel, and Joseph visit Jesus in the Garden of Gethsemane? No, probably not. So does that make Episode 8 unbiblical? Hardly. As all of redemptive history is culminating in Jesus, it makes perfect sense to weave in these Old Testament stories that prefigure Him—at least, that’s what our Bible consultants say. Listen as they unpack the deep and meaningful ways Jesus is fulfilling scriptural prophecies and patterns as He begins his sufferings in Gethsemane.

episodes.name: The Spy Who Fed Me: His Journey from Angsty Songs to Anxious Pharisee
episodes.overview:
Shmuel may be wrong, but Shaan Sharma plays him so right. For five seasons now, he’s given us a complex character whose sincere faith and devotion make him the most outspoken critic of Jesus.

In this episode, Elijah serves up Shaan’s favorite snack and soda as they discuss his critical portrayal and what came before it…including a stint as a singer/songwriter.

episodes.name: The Spy Who Fed Me: From Child Actor to Youthful Pontius Pilate
episodes.overview: In this episode, Andrew James Allen gets invited to a meal in his own office—the Roman headquarters where he presides as governor Pontius Pilate. If you’ve seen other depictions of Pilate, you might think Andrew’s a bit young to play the part, but he’s been doing things early his whole life, starting his acting career at just 9 years old. Elijah and Andrew reflect on those child acting days that eventually led to this incredibly mature and complex role.

episodes.name: The Complete Last Supper
episodes.overview: In honor of what took place on this night over 2,000 years ago, we give you our portrayal of the Last Supper. Pulled from all eight of our Season Five episodes, here in continuous, chronological order.

episodes.name: I Have Called You by Name
episodes.overview: Two brothers struggle with their tax debts to Rome while a woman in the Red Quarter wrestles with her demons.

episodes.name: Shabbat
episodes.overview: Matthew validates Simon's claims with Praetor Quintus, Nicodemus investigates the miracle reported in the Red Quarter, and Mary receives surprise guests at her Shabbat dinner.

episodes.name: Jesus Loves the Little Children
episodes.overview: Jesus befriends and teaches the group of children who discover His camp on the outskirts of Capernaum.

episodes.name: The Rock on Which it is Built
episodes.overview: With his life and family under threat from Rome, Simon spends one last night fishing in a desperate attempt to square his debts. Andrew spots a familiar face waiting for them on the shores of Galilee.

episodes.name: The Wedding Gift
episodes.overview: Nicodemus interrogates John the Baptizer while Jesus and his students make their way to a wedding celebration in Cana. When the wine runs low, Mary asks her son to intervene on behalf of the bridegroom's family.

episodes.name: Indescribable Compassion
episodes.overview: After witnessing the healing of a leper on the road to Capernaum, a woman brings her paralytic friend through the crowd to meet Jesus.

episodes.name: Invitations
episodes.overview: Matthew struggles to reconcile the miracles he has witnessed with reality. Nicodemus meets with Jesus by night.

episodes.name: I Am He
episodes.overview: Jesus and His students complete their preparations and leave Capernaum for Samaria. Jesus meets with a suffering woman at Jacob's Well and announces that He is the Messiah.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A charismatic fisherman drowning in debt. A troubled woman wrestling with real demons. A gifted publican ostracized by his family and his people. A religious leader struggling with his beliefs. See Jesus through the eyes of those who met Him.

episodes.name: Thunder
episodes.overview: Tension builds among the disciples as they wrestle with the increasing fame of Jesus in Samaria. Jesus rebukes Big James and John for their prejudice and, after a near-violent encounter, gives them a new nickname.

episodes.name: I Saw You
episodes.overview: A mysterious visitor seeks to meet Jesus, but the disciples are hesitant. Tension builds between Simon and Matthew. As the group heads to a new city, word arrives that Jesus’ fame is growing.

episodes.name: Matthew 4:24
episodes.overview: A long, exhausting day turns into night as the disciples help Jesus deal with a large crowd hoping to be healed. Around the campfire, over dinner, the group tried to get to know each other better. But tensions erupt.

episodes.name: The Perfect Opportunity
episodes.overview: As Jesus and the disciples head to Jerusalem to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles, a new enemy follows them, while a familiar enemy awaits.

episodes.name: Spirit
episodes.overview: After stirring the water, Jesus is now pursued by Simon the Zealot, Atticus, and Shmuel. John the Baptizer visits the group and tells Jesus his dangerous mission. Meanwhile, back at the camp, Mary Magdalene is devastated by an encounter with a mysterious and dangerous stranger.

episodes.name: Unlawful
episodes.overview: Matthew and Simon try to get along as they search for Mary in dark places. The group fears for Mary as they struggle with lack of food and bad news about John the Baptist. Meanwhile, Jesus continues to upset Pharisees across multiple regions.

episodes.name: Reckoning
episodes.overview: After learning of Jesus' whereabouts, Quintus sends Gaius to arrest him. The disciples lose control as they argue about how to respond. While seeking information about where Jesus has been taken, Andrew and Philip encounter old friends.

episodes.name: Beyond Mountains
episodes.overview: While Jesus and Matthew prepare the content of the big sermon, the disciples spread the word while fighting amongst themselves. A high-ranking Sanhedrin member is shocked by Shmuel’s reports on Jesus. Thousands arrive for the sermon, including familiar faces.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Tensions rise as Jesus and his disciples take the ministry on the road. With increased fame comes more redemption and healing, but also more enemies.

episodes.name: Homecoming
episodes.overview: Jesus delivers the most life-altering sermon in history. The result? More followers, more enemies, and disciples ready to follow Jesus anywhere. Simon and Eden reunite, Matthew faces his past, and Andrew visits John the Baptist in prison.

episodes.name: Two by Two
episodes.overview: Jesus is a problem for the Romans. With pilgrims from everywhere setting up a tent city at the gates of Capernaum to see Jesus, tensions rise. Jesus officially sends the twelve apostles on an exciting but dangerous mission, causing Little James to ask why he hasn’t been healed.

episodes.name: Physician, Heal Yourself
episodes.overview: Jesus returns to his childhood home for the big Jewish new year celebration. His childhood friends and family are all buzzing with what they’ve heard about Jesus…until he tells them the truth of who He is.

episodes.name: Clean, Part 1
episodes.overview: Two by two, the disciples carry out Jesus’ mission to heal, cast out demons, and preach his  words. But upon returning, they struggle with understanding what happened while Simon and  Eden struggle to reconnect.

episodes.name: Clean, Part 2
episodes.overview: As tensions mount at home, Simon and Gaius work together to fix the water problem in Capernaum. Meanwhile, Jairus and Veronica are equally desperate to find Jesus as the only hope for their crises.

episodes.name: Intensity in Tent City
episodes.overview: Andrew and Philip discover their previous mission resulted in devastation that will require a return. Simon Z is finally forced to confront his past, but then two disciples of John the Baptist come to Capernaum with an important question for Jesus.

episodes.name: Ears to Hear
episodes.overview: "Having ears to hear." Jesus leads the disciples into a dangerous region, where they will face a crowd armed with sharp tongues and dull ears… but even his closest followers are finding it very hard to hear.

episodes.name: Sustenance
episodes.overview: Thousands arrive to first argue with, then listen to Jesus as he preaches. Shmuel and Atticus hear what’s happening and journey towards the Decapolis to catch Jesus in the act of a possible revolt. Meanwhile, as the preaching extends to the next day, the disciples realize they have a significant problem: the thousands are hungry, and there’s no food.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Jesus gives a sermon that turns the world upside down, and all 12 disciples are ready to follow him to the ends of the earth.

episodes.name: Promises
episodes.overview: An intoxicating dance leads Herod to put an end to John the Baptizer, but no one can stop what-or Who-he's ushered in.

episodes.name: Confessions
episodes.overview: Jesus founds his church on unholy ground and Simon goes public with Jesus' true identity, getting a new name in the process. But can the new "Peter" forgive old wrongs?

episodes.name: Moon to Blood
episodes.overview: When Jesus heals a blind man on the Sabbath, religious leaders confront him, drawing a riotous crowd. Gaius defies a direct order leading Quintus to take matters—and someone’s life—into his own hands.

episodes.name: Calm Before
episodes.overview: Beginning with a funeral procession, time marches rapidly toward the final days of Jesus’ ministry. While the disciples seek status for themselves, a Roman ruler comes with a humble request.

episodes.name: Sitting, Serving, Scheming
episodes.overview: Roman soldiers demand the disciples carry their armor, but Jesus goes one step farther. Frustrated by the direction of Jesus’ ministry, Judas visits an old friend for advice.

episodes.name: Dedication
episodes.overview: Jesus and the disciples celebrate Hanukkah. Matthew confronts Judas about irregularities, and the festival turns into a fight, then flight. The disciples escape with their lives, but learn a friend hasn’t been so lucky.

episodes.name: The Last Sign
episodes.overview: Jesus brings Lazarus back to life—and sets off the chain of events that will lead to His own death.

episodes.name: Humble
episodes.overview: Jesus refuses to look and act like the Messiah everyone expects—arriving like a lamb instead of a lion and riding a donkey instead of a war horse.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: After preaching to a crowd of more than 5,000 people in Galilee and performing a miracle by walking on water, Jesus’ actions increasingly anger Jewish authorities.

episodes.name: Entry
episodes.overview: Jesus rides into the holy city as king, but finds that the rulers have turned His Father’s house from a place of prayer to a corrupt market.

episodes.name: House of Cards
episodes.overview: Why kill Jesus when Rome can do it for you? As the Jewish High Priest schemes to bring Him down, Jesus strikes first: turning the tables.

episodes.name: Woes
episodes.overview: Jesus preaches one last time to the massive Passover crowd, and the religious leaders try to trap him in his words.

episodes.name: The Same Coin
episodes.overview: Afraid of public outcry—and further embarrassment—Caiaphas resolves to arrest Jesus quietly at night. Only one problem: no one knows how to find Him.

episodes.name: Because of Me
episodes.overview: The decision to arrest Jesus leads to a fiery debate. Roman soldiers track down a troublemaking crowd. Shmuel finds help from an unexpected source.

episodes.name: Reunions
episodes.overview: As Jesus’ followers gather for the Passover meal, His enemies assemble for a man hunt. Judas holds a secret meeting.

episodes.name: The Upper Room (1)
episodes.overview: Jesus arrives at the Last Supper. The disciples fear for their safety as Jesus’ enemies close ranks around them.

episodes.name: The Upper Room (2)
episodes.overview: Pilate summons Atticus to read him the riot act. The Sanhedrin boils over. The Last Supper ends.

seasons.name: Last Supper
seasons.overview: From triumph to betrayal: Jesus enters Jerusalem acclaimed as king and confronts corrupt temple merchants. While religious leaders plot against his growing influence, he shares a final meal with his disciples. In the shadows, Judas' treachery sets in motion events that would transform history. This tale of sacrifice becomes humanity's most profound story.
